title: Build & deploy AI-powered apps — Paige Bailey, Google DeepMind
talk_summary: This is a demo-heavy Google DeepMind product tour of Gemini 3.1, AI Studio, Gemma 4, Genie 3, Lyria and Veo, not an engineering talk about building agent systems.

takeaways.technique: Small model + tools beats big model
takeaways.what_they_do: They run the smallest/cheapest model (Flash-Lite) with tools like code execution and search grounding enabled, and it solves tasks the larger model also solves but slower and costlier.
takeaways.evidence_quote: strongly strongly recommend experimenting with the the smaller weight models especially turning on these tools to help them do their work more effectively
takeaways.numbers: Bounding-box task on a ~1,000-token image done 'well under a fraction of the penny' on Flash-Lite; Flash slightly more but still under a penny

takeaways.technique: Sandboxed code execution as an auto-invocable tool
takeaways.what_they_do: The model gets a sandboxed Python environment with data-science libraries preinstalled and can invoke them as sub-tools to compute answers rather than hallucinate them.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we give Gemini a sandboxed environment with Python and a whole bunch of data science libraries pre-installed where it can kind of pull in those libraries as tools

takeaways.what_they_do: Models expose minimal/low/medium/high thinking budgets; the speaker keeps it low for routine work and raises it only for hard reasoning.
takeaways.evidence_quote: I often just keep it on minimal or low just for time's sake

takeaways.what_they_do: Instead of standing up a vector DB, they pass a short list of URLs directly into the context window and have the model cite them inline.
takeaways.evidence_quote: URL context, which gives you kind of like poor man's retrieval

takeaways.what_they_do: Genie 3 is described as a composition of several models (image, video, prompting) stitched together rather than one monolith.
takeaways.evidence_quote: Genie 3 is actually a composition of models. So, it's not just one model
